description: This file is a shell script for testing Git submodule and worktree functionalities, including setup, adding worktrees, updating submodules, and verifying configuration consistency.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes within a specified directory, used for setting up repository states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and verifies success.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, runs commands and checks for expected failure.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks for a specific exit code from a command.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file's content is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and checks for differences.
